findings.desc: doc-code-drift: CLAUDE.md line 874 states story_dispatch / finding_dispatch are deprecated aliases still usable (仍可用但 stderr 告警), but B-a4e3 CHK-005 fully removed them — cli-engine.ts:1900-1901 and command-policy.ts:330 both carry explicit removal comments. Agents following CLAUDE.md will attempt lattice story_dispatch / lattice finding_dispatch and get command-not-found errors.

doc-code-drift: packages/main/src/core/config.ts line 12 JSDoc still says `<projectRoot>/.koala/audit-config.json` as the project-level override path. B-a4e3 removed the .koala read fallback in audit-config.ts (confirmed via diff: LEGACY_KOALA_DIR import removed, legacy read path removed), but the JSDoc in config.ts was not updated. Should now read `.lattice/audit-config.json` matching the implementation and the corrected CLAUDE.md.

spec-boundary: docs/requirements/decisions/dev-memory.md lines 30-31 still state "The legacy .koala/dev-memory/experience.jsonl and ~/.koala/dev-memory/experience.jsonl paths are read-only fallback inputs for migrated installations" but CHK-001 removed resolveLegacyProjectMemoryPath + resolveLegacyGlobalMemoryPath from core/dev-memory.ts. The spec doc was not updated to reflect the removal. An operator reading dev-memory.md would believe the fallback still exists. Suggest updating lines 30-31 to note that the legacy .koala read fallback was removed in B-a4e3.
